label: def:motivic-mass-measure
title: Motivic mass measure $\mu$ on the brane arc space
html:
Let K_0(\mathrm{Var}_k) be the Grothendieck ring of varieties over the base field k — the free abelian group on isomorphism classes [X] of k-varieties modulo the scissor relations [X] = [Z] + [X \setminus Z] for closed Z \subseteq X, with product [X] \cdot [Y] = [X \times Y]. Let \mathbb{L} = [\mathbb{A}^1_k] \in K_0(\mathrm{Var}_k) denote the Lefschetz motive, and write \mathcal{M} := K_0(\mathrm{Var}_k)[\mathbb{L}^{-1}] for its localization. The motivic mass measure of the QOU brane is the Kontsevich--Denef--Loeser motivic measure

  \mu \;:\; \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{L}(X))
  \;\longrightarrow\;
  \widehat{\mathcal{M}}

on cylindrical (Borel) subsets of the arc space \mathcal{L}(X) of a brane variety X, valued in the dimension-completion \widehat{\mathcal{M}} of \mathcal{M}. Volumes of measurable subsets are computed by

  \mu(A)
  \;=\;
  [\pi_n(A)] \;\mathbb{L}^{-(n+1)\dim X}
  \qquad
  (\pi_n \colon \mathcal{L}(X) \to \mathcal{L}_n(X)),

independently of n once A is stable at level n.

For a braid \beta \in H_n(R, q) whose Gröbner--Shirshov reduction (three-parameter Wedderburn formula) blows up X along its crossing loci, the topological mass of the reduced state is

  \mathfrak{m}_{\mathrm{mot}}(\beta)
  \;:=\;
  \int_{\mathcal{L}(X)} d\mu
  \;\in\;\widehat{\mathcal{M}}.
